capabilities: Insert bullet points on new lines
Sync the system clipboard with Vim yank and paste
Add optional visual-line motions for j/k/0/$/_/A/I/V
extras: The README states a plan to integrate functionality like nvim-mini/mini.surround in the future; this is not yet implemented. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds some handy features to obsidians built in vim mode.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Vim mode lacks conveniences found in standalone Vim, like yank highlighting, system clipboard sync, and some visual-line motions.
summary: Adds quality-of-life features to Obsidian's built-in Vim mode, such as yank highlighting, clipboard sync, and visual-line motions.
